item.title: ON THIS DAY IN OUR HISTORY: Give the hospital more funds: Angry leader
item.description: More funds should be allocated to increase the number of nurses and doctors at Port Moresby General Hospital.

item.title: PM praises Nasfund’s performance and reform-led growth
item.description: The Prime Minister of Papua New Guinea, the James Marape, MP, visited Nasfund’s Head Office in Port Moresby today, where he met with the Board, management, and staff to commend the institution’s role in delivering strong outcomes for Papua New Guineans.

item.title: Australia, PNG strengthen disaster preparedness partnership
item.description: A senior delegation from Australia’s National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) recently visited Papua New Guinea (15–20 March) to meet with key partners and stakeholders, and to ensure that both nations are better prepared, more resilient, and faster to respond when natural disasters strike.

item.title: Madang commemorates World TB Day and National Council of Women Day
item.description: Madang marked World Tuberculosis Day on March 24, 2026, under the theme “Yes! We Can End TB in PNG,” alongside celebrations of National Council of Women Day.

item.title: Alluvial Gold Mining sustains livelihoods along the Ok Tedi River
item.description: Alluvial mining along the Ok Tedi River remains a key source of income for communities in the North Fly District, with people of all ages relying on the activity to support their daily needs.

item.title: New law and justice partnership empowers Bougainville students
item.description: Bougainville’s students will gain new opportunities to learn about respect, safety, and justice through a pioneering partnership between schools and the law and justice sector. The program will help young people understand their rights and responsibilities, encourage positive behavior, and create safer schools, and an investment in Bougainville’s future.

item.title: Successful academy program relaunches under PNGRFL
item.description: The Papua New Guinea Rugby Football League (PNGRFL) is delighted to relaunch the highly successful PNG NRL Academy as the PNGRFL Academy, with the program coming under the management and oversight of the national governing body.
